title: Bash cat ./.env: hook throws uncaught exception and exits 1
reason_not_testable: Requires the PostToolUse hook to throw, exit 1 and emit no JSON. No fixture kind can inject a hook crash, and a normal-path redaction fixture would not prove the crash-path outcome. Non-hook control: code review that the hook body is wrapped to always exit 0 with a withheld updatedToolOutput.
